proposals.after: His grandson Shu inherited the hereditary rank and rose to commander of the Dengzhou garrison in Shandong.
proposals.reason: 孫 means 'grandson', not the surname Sun; the corrupted glyph is the given name 澍 (Shu).

proposals.after: His grandson Shu inherited the hereditary office and rose to be commander of the Dengzhou garrison in Shandong.

decisions.reason: s0075 has 濟隆呼圖克圖, the Jilong Khutuktu; Jebtsundamba would require 哲布尊丹巴 and is a different lineage. The rest of the sentence (reappointment, Baringol to Ili, Sarlar’s pastures) is already accurate.
The literal field likewise misidentifies 濟隆呼圖克圖 as Jebtsundamba; Jilong Khutuktu restores the correct reading without altering the surrounding accurate phrasing.
s0175 opens 孫{澍}: 孫 is the kinship term ‘grandson’, not the surname Sun, and the personal name is 澍 (Shu). Removing the invented surname leaves an accurate inheritance and Dengzhou appointment.
The literal repeats the same error: 孫 is ‘grandson’ and the given name is 澍; ‘His grandson Shu’ matches the Chinese without inventing a surname Sun.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows English Jebtsundamba Khutuktu came only from mistranslating 濟隆呼圖克圖; the religious-name claim must read Jilong Khutuktu while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
